response.rationale: Option D is ranked first because it is the only option that matches a leaf (Eisenmenger Syndrome with Patent Foramen Ovale) with an 'equivalent' relation type and has the highest support and confidence scores. The remaining options are unmatched and are ordered based on their prior option ranks, with A, B, and C having the same prior rank, so their relative order is arbitrary among themselves but they must be after D.
